_comment: ADR-037 register fragment - the-decision-as-a-walked-process task 10.2 (REQ-DWP-010). A committee stage that becomes active is placed as an agenda item on its body's next regular meeting (the stage's `agendaItem`, from fragment 46; `placementPending` while the body has no such meeting yet). When the body records a decision on that agenda item, the stage closes with the body's outcome, the date of the decision and the meeting it was taken in: `decidedInMeeting`, added here. Properties only, so no schema version moves, as in 137-a-committee-step-names-its-body.

decidedInMeeting.title: Decided in meeting
decidedInMeeting.description: The meeting in which the committee body decided this stage. Set when the body's decision on the stage's agenda item closes a `committee` stage; empty on every other stage (REQ-DWP-010).
